summary: Re-test of the 3 critical + 5 medium fixes in the 'Bannr' frontend-only banner builder (Vite+React19, no backend). ALL 6 RETEST ITEMS PASS. Verified: (1) artboard aspect ratio now exact for preset-ig-post (1.000), preset-ig-story (0.562), preset-ad-mrec (1.200), preset-vid-land (1.778) and template-t-yt (1.778) - backgrounds fill the artboard and added layers stay inside its bounds; (2) animated mode toggle gets the bg-accent active class, mode-static loses it, play advances time-display (0.0s -> 1.5s), the 'rise' animation is observed on the layer (opacity 0.70 -> 1, translateY 8.3px -> 0), a right-trimmed clip's layer node is removed from the DOM once the playhead passes its end and reappears when scrubbed back, Export offers MP4/GIF in Animated and PNG/JPG (no MP4) in Static; (3) double-tap text edit commits in CORRECT order on blur ('LIVE EDITED'); (4) project-title is visible (114x32.5 at 390px viewport) and tappable -> project-title-input -> rename persists, undo/redo removed; (5) all 6 primary tools fit inside the 390px toolbar (last tool right edge 364 < 390); (6) default zoom fits the 5s project, trim-r handle reachable without scrolling (x+w=325 < 390) and right-trim works (clip 250px -> 96px), zoom-in/out work (250->400->250), time-display formats as '3.6s / 5.0s', split-btn is disabled. Regression pass: home (Recent x3, Templates x6), preset picker with 4 category tabs (6/6/3/4 presets), add text/shape/sticker/stock-image, background solid+gradient+image applied to artboard, font(7)/color(12)/align(3) panels, duplicate/delete, layers panel show/hide, back navigation. `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean (excluding the known unused ui/routes leftovers). ZERO console/pageerror events across all flows.

ui_bugs.issue: LOW (behavioural nit, not the old reversal bug): on double-tap the caret lands at offset 0 instead of selecting/placing at the tapped word, so typing without first pressing End prepends text ('HELLO' + 'Add a heading' -> 'HELLOAdd a heading'). Character order is correct, but users tapping to edit will prepend rather than append. Consider selecting all content (or placing the caret via the pointer position) when entering edit mode.

LOW: with 4+ layers the lower clip rows fall below the visible timeline area (measured clip bottom 882 vs 844 device frame at 390x844). The track (h-40, overflow-auto) does scroll vertically but there is no scroll affordance, so lower rows and their trim handles look inaccessible. Consider a taller track on tall viewports or a fade/scroll hint.

LOW: pointerdown on a clip stops propagation, so tapping anywhere on a clip selects the layer but never moves the playhead. Scrubbing only works on empty track/ruler space. Acceptable, but a dedicated ruler-only scrub strip (or scrub-on-drag over clips) would be more predictable.

issues: Artboard uses only 86% of the smaller canvas dimension, so wide presets (16:9, 300x250) leave a large empty checkerboard area above/below the banner. Not a defect, but a fit-to-width scale would use the mobile screen better.
The category tab strip is horizontally scrollable and after selecting the last tab the first tab ('Social Media') is partially cut off with no fade/scroll affordance.
search-btn is still a dead control (no behaviour) - carry-over from iteration_1; either wire it or remove it.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: place the caret (or select-all) when entering text edit mode so typing does not prepend.
OPTIONAL/LOW: make lower timeline rows discoverable (taller track or scroll affordance) when a project has 4+ layers.
OPTIONAL/LOW: remove or wire the dead home search-btn.
Consider adding `tsc --noEmit` to the build script - it currently passes and would have caught the iteration_1 `mode` bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixes verified in code: store/editor.tsx now exposes `mode: state.project.mode` with memoized value + useCallback actions; Canvas artboard has `shrink-0` and `active = mode==='animated' && !(!playing && time===0)`; contentEditable is uncontrolled and commits on blur; Timeline default ppms 0.05 + fmt() in seconds + split disabled; Toolbar w-14 buttons.
Canvas.tsx anim(): the entrance animation duration is hard-coded to 450ms; move it to a constant/per-layer field before the backend phase.
Timeline.tsx keyframe-btn now uses a safe find + guard (good). Panels.tsx selected-only sheets are guarded (good).
No persistence layer: renames/layers/background are lost on Home navigation and Recent thumbnails never update - expected for the mock prototype, but blocking for real usage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 retest items and all regression checks passed (0 critical, 0 high; 3 LOW polish items)

All iteration_1 criticals are fixed and verified. Testing gotchas: (a) '[data-testid^="layer-"]' also matches layer-row-/layer-vis-/layer-up- rows in the Layers sheet - scope to the canvas when counting layers; (b) tool sheets do NOT close on Escape, click [data-testid=sheet-close]; (c) bg swatch testids contain '#' (e.g. bg-color-#FF3B30) so quote the attribute value in selectors; (d) timeline clips for the 4th+ layer sit below the 844px viewport - pick a clip whose bounding box bottom <= viewport height before dragging trim handles; (e) scrub by clicking empty track space, not on a clip; (f) the preset picker keeps the last selected category tab, click cat-Social Media before preset-ig-post.
rca_of_the_issue: No new defects. The two apparent failures during testing were test-harness artifacts: a right-trim drag failed because the targeted clip was vertically outside the 844px viewport, and a scrub click failed because it landed on a clip (which stops propagation) - both reproduced correctly once retargeted.
